World

  • Ukraine wants to scale its drone war to 1,000 a day. President Zelensky said he plans for the army to launch at least a thousand drones a day into Russia — more than triple the current pace — as both sides keep up nightly barrages; Russia sent 160+ drones at Ukraine overnight, half of them jet-powered. An escalation of attrition, not a move toward talks. Al Jazeera Ukrinform
  • A first hint of an off-ramp in the Gulf. Iran’s foreign minister said renewed talks with Washington “aren’t impossible” if U.S. pressure eases, and Tehran and Oman floated a plan for a temporary shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz plus a demining effort. Traffic is still choked — only five ships crossed on Tuesday versus a normal 130 — but it’s the first real talk of de-escalation. CNBC CNN
  • Science: light-activated eye drops restored sight in blind mice. An IBEC-led consortium in Barcelona made small light-responsive molecules (“prosthe6”) that mimic dead photoreceptors; delivered as eye drops, they let fully blind mice perceive light and recover visually guided behaviour — no gene therapy, implants or special lighting. Early and animal-stage, but a promising route for macular degeneration and retinitis pigmentosa. ScienceDaily EurekAlert
